es.name: MoviesCompose
es.description: Aplicación sencilla que consulta una API de películas con Retrofit y guarda los resultados en una base de datos con Room, utilizando Android Jetpack.

en.name: MoviesCompose
en.description: A simple app that uses Retrofit to fetch movies from an API and stores the results in a Room database, using Android Jetpack.

es.name: DogeDex

en.name: DogeDex
en.description: An app that scans dogs, identifies them using TensorFlow Lite and saves them in a database.
